description.value: Bin 4 Burger Lounge is a BC-grown burger chain with a South Granville location serving creative smashed-patty burgers, bowls, and salads using locally sourced ingredients including premium BC beef and Rossdown Farms chicken. The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating and a full bar program, making it a substantial stop for hungry cyclists on the Granville Street corridor. Plant-based and vegetarian diners are well catered for, with tofu substitutions available across the menu.
